title: Potent Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Metabolites of Pongamia pinnata Stems and Their Role in NF-kappaB and PI3K/AKT/mTOR Signaling Pathways Regulation in Irradiated Rats.
authors: Ismail, Ahmed; Abdou, Fatma Y; Gharib, Ola A; Hawas, Asrar M; Sherif, Noheir; Saleh, Abdulrahman M; Abdelsalam, Kholoud M; Aboelmagd, Mohamed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水黄皮茎代谢物的抗氧化抗炎作用及对NF-kB和PI3K/AKT/mTOR通路的调控，仅含少量分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The objective of the work is to present a comprehensive analysis of the bioactive metabolites present in Pongamia pinnata (Pp) stems. The radioprotective properties of Pp against gamma radiation-induced inflammation in vivo were also clarified. A single acute dose of whole-body gamma radiation (7 Gy) was administered to the rats. For 10 days, the herbal extract was administered orally by gavage at doses of 300 and 1000 mg/kg. The irradiated group administered with Pp 70% ethanolic extract showed a significant reduction in testicular and renal oxidative stress markers, such as reduced glutathione and malondialdehyde. Pretreatment with Pp showed notable improvements in biomarkers (nuclear factor kappa B [NF-kappaB], phosphoinositide 3-kinases [PI3K], Akt, and mTOR) in testis and renal tissues. Both the incidence of sperm head abnormalities and the serum levels of urea and creatinine were markedly reduced in irradiated rats that had been pretreated with Pp herbal extract. The docking study concentrated on the ability of the herbal extract's most active metabolites, beta-sitosterol, stigmasterol, betulinic acid, and ponganone XI, to bind to the NF-kappaB, PI3K, Akt, and mTOR target sites. Pp stem includes a variety of pharmacological properties that modulate the PI3K/Akt/mTOR pathway, including possible antioxidant and anti-inflammatory compounds.
abstract_zh: 本工作的目标是全面分析水黄皮（Pongamia pinnata, Pp）茎中存在的生物活性代谢物，并阐明Pp对伽马辐射诱导的体内炎症的辐射防护特性。对大鼠给予单次急性剂量（7 Gy）的全身伽马辐射。连续10天，通过灌胃给予草药提取物，剂量为300和1000 mg/kg。接受Pp 70%乙醇提取物的辐射组，其睾丸和肾脏氧化应激标志物（如还原型谷胱甘肽和丙二醛）显著降低。Pp预处理在睾丸和肾组织中显示出生物标志物（核因子κB [NF-kappaB]、磷酸肌醇3-激酶 [PI3K]、Akt 和 mTOR）的显著改善。在经Pp草药提取物预处理的辐射大鼠中，精子头部异常发生率以及血清尿素和肌酐水平均显著降低。对接研究集中于草药提取物中最活跃的代谢物——β-谷甾醇、豆甾醇、桦木酸和ponganone XI——与NF-kappaB、PI3K、Akt和mTOR靶位点结合的能力。Pp茎包含多种药理特性，可调节PI3K/Akt/mTOR通路，包括潜在的抗氧化和抗炎化合物。
